places.name: Vaduz Castle (Exterior Viewpoint)
places.ai_summary: A historic castle perched above Vaduz, offering stunning views of the city and the Rhine Valley.

opening_hours.notes: Interior not open to the public.

places.place_tip: Capture panoramic photos from the viewpoint.

attribution.title: Liechtenstein asv2022-10 img22 Vaduz Schloss
attribution.author: A.Savin
attribution.description: Vaduz Castle (town side) in Vaduz, Liechtenstein

places.name: Kunstmuseum Liechtenstein (Modern Art)
places.ai_summary: A modern art museum in Vaduz, featuring contemporary works and rotating exhibitions from international artists.

opening_hours.notes: Free entry on the first Sunday of each month.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the sculpture garden outside the museum.

attribution.title: KML HAF aussen vom Staedtle Barbara Buehler
attribution.author: Mart2000

places.name: Hilti Art Foundation
places.ai_summary: An extension of the Kunstmuseum, showcasing a private collection of modern and classical art pieces.

opening_hours.notes: Combined tickets available with Kunstmuseum.

places.place_tip: Explore the thematic exhibitions for unique insights.

attribution.title: KML HAF aussen vom Staedtle Barbara Buehler
attribution.author: Mart2000

places.name: Liechtenstein National Museum
places.ai_summary: The principal museum in Liechtenstein, presenting the history, culture, and art of the principality.

opening_hours.notes: Free entry on the first Sunday of each month.

places.place_tip: Check out the medieval armory and the natural history section.

attribution.title: Prince Alois of Liechtenstein 2024 (cropped)
attribution.author: Information und Kommunikation der Regierung, Vaduz
attribution.description: Stefan Barriga, HSH Hereditary Prince Alois of Liechtenstein and Árni Páll Árnason during a EFTA courtesy visit to Vaduz Castle.

places.name: Liechtenstein Postal Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to the postal history of Liechtenstein, featuring exhibits on philately and postal services.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Visit the gift shop for unique postal-themed souvenirs.

attribution.title: Engländerbau
attribution.author: St9191
attribution.description: "Engländerbau" in Vaduz, the capital of Liechtenstein: location of the Postmuseum of Liechtenstein

places.name: St. Florin Cathedral
places.ai_summary: The main church in Vaduz, known for its impressive architecture and beautiful stained glass windows.

opening_hours.notes: Mass times may restrict visiting hours.

places.place_tip: Attend a concert if available, the acoustics are remarkable.

attribution.title: Liechtenstein asv2022-10 img21 Vaduz Kathedrale StFlorin
attribution.author: A.Savin
attribution.description: Cathedral of St. Florin in Vaduz, Liechtenstein

places.name: Government Building (Regierungsgebäude)
places.ai_summary: The administrative center of Liechtenstein, notable for its modern architecture and historical significance.

opening_hours.notes: Check for any public events or restrictions.

places.place_tip: Look out for the Liechtenstein flag, a symbol of the principality's sovereignty.

places.name: Städtle Pedestrian Street
places.ai_summary: The main shopping street in Vaduz, lined with boutiques, cafes, and shops, perfect for a leisurely stroll.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited on foot.

places.place_tip: Stop by the local bakeries for a taste of Liechtenstein's famous pastries.

places.name: Red House (Rotes Haus) Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: A viewpoint offering a unique perspective of the Red House, a historic building in Vaduz, and the surrounding area.

opening_hours.notes: Best light for photos is in the morning.

places.place_tip: The viewpoint is especially beautiful in winter when the Red House is surrounded by snow.

attribution.title: The Great Red Dragon and the Woman Clothed with the Sun
attribution.author: William Blake
attribution.description: William Blake (British, 1757-1827). The Great Red Dragon and the Woman Clothed with the Sun (Rev. 12: 1-4), ca. 1803-1805. The handwritten caption reads: "And the tail of the great red dragon drew the third part of the stars of heaven and did cast them to the earth. And the dragon stood before the woman which was ready to be delivered for to devour her child as soon as it was born". Black ink and watercolor over traces of graphite and incised lines, Image: 17 3/16 x 13 11/16 in. (43.7 x 34.8 cm). Brooklyn Museum, Gift of William Augustus White, 15.368

places.name: Alte Rheinbrücke (Wooden Covered Bridge)
places.ai_summary: A picturesque wooden bridge in Vaduz, offering a scenic walk and great views of the Rhine River.

opening_hours.notes: The bridge is not accessible to vehicles.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a walk along the Rhine for a complete experience.

places.name: Peter-Kaiser-Platz
places.ai_summary: A central square in Vaduz, often used for events and gatherings, surrounded by important buildings.

opening_hours.notes: Check local listings for events.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby cafes for a taste of local cuisine.

places.name: Liechtenstein Center (Tourist Info & Passport Stamp)
places.ai_summary: The official tourist information center in Vaduz, where visitors can get information and a passport stamp.

opening_hours.notes: Passport stamps available during opening hours.

places.place_tip: Ask about the Liechtenstein Adventure Pass for discounts on local attractions.

attribution.title: View of Triesenberg
attribution.author: Lucas Kendall
attribution.description: An unobstructed view of the main section of Triesenberg, Liechtenstein. In the distance the Hoher Kasten peak can be seen.

places.name: Hofkellerei des Fürsten von Liechtenstein (Winery)
places.ai_summary: The winery of the Prince of Liechtenstein, offering tours and tastings of their exclusive wines.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking recommended for tours.

places.place_tip: Try the local specialty, Liechtenstein Tafelwein.

attribution.title: 3156 - Vaduz - Hintergass vom Mitteldorf
attribution.author: Andrew Bossi
attribution.description: Behind Lane viewed from Mitteldorf, Vaduz, Liechtenstein

places.name: Rheinpark Stadion (Tour)
places.ai_summary: The national stadium of Liechtenstein, offering tours that showcase its modern facilities and history.

opening_hours.notes: Check schedule for tour availability.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a walk in the nearby Rheinpark.

attribution.title: The Rheinpark Stadium before a UEFA Nations League match (2022)
attribution.author: Vincenzo.togni
attribution.description: The Rheinpark Stadium in Vaduz before a UEFA Nations League match (2022)

places.name: Vaduz Citytrain Panorama Ride
places.ai_summary: A scenic train ride through Vaduz, offering panoramic views of the city, castle, and surrounding landscapes.

opening_hours.notes: Limited service in winter months.

places.place_tip: Sit on the upper deck for the best views.

places.name: Treasure Chamber (Landesmuseum Schatzkammer)
places.ai_summary: A museum showcasing the treasures of Liechtenstein, including royal regalia, historical artifacts, and art pieces.

opening_hours.notes: Free entry on the first Sunday of each month.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for detailed explanations of the exhibits.

attribution.title: Rainer Vollkommer, Berlin 2022
attribution.author: OliverMarkCC

places.name: Art in Public Places Sculpture Walk
places.ai_summary: A walk through Vaduz featuring various sculptures and art installations in public spaces.

opening_hours.notes: Best enjoyed at a leisurely pace.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the unique artworks.

places.name: Fürstenkino & Cultural Events Strip
places.ai_summary: A cultural venue in Vaduz offering a cinema, theater, and various events throughout the year.

opening_hours.notes: Check schedule for movie and event times.

places.place_tip: Look out for film festivals and special cultural events.

places.name: Castle Trail (Schlossweg) Lookouts
places.ai_summary: Scenic lookouts along the Castle Trail in Vaduz, offering breathtaking views of the castle and the Rhine Valley.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in good weather.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for the trail.

places.name: Sunset Walk along the Rhine Embankment
places.ai_summary: A picturesque walk along the Rhine Embankment in Vaduz, ideal for watching the sunset.

opening_hours.notes: Best enjoyed at a leisurely pace.

places.place_tip: Bring a blanket and enjoy a picnic by the river.
